The description uses 'blau' (blue) for Exporte Deutschlands, but the image shows 'dunkelblau' (dark blue). While 'blau' is a reasonable approximation, the atom specifies 'dunkelblau'.
The description does not explicitly mention the exact position of the legend (below the diagram).
